info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: This API allows users to efficiently cancel multiple airline flight reservations in a single operation. It caters to travel agencies and airlines that need to manage customer bookings effectively, ensuring timely updates for flight cancellations. By utilizing this API, consumers can streamline their operations, saving time and reducing manual errors associated with flight cancellations. The endpoint supports bulk cancellations, making it particularly useful in scenarios such as mass flight changes or customer service interventions.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a flight that they have previously booked. It will remove the flight reservation from the system and update the status accordingly. Ensure that you have the proper authorization to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a flight. It should include the necessary information required to identify the flight that needs to be canceled. Ensure that the provided data conforms to the specified schema, and that all required fields are included.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a flight operation using the DELETE method. It is a string type that typically contains the necessary information to process the cancellation request.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_201.title: Flight Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the flight cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_201.description: Schema representing the response returned upon successful cancellation of a flight.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information related to the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The total time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. This value helps in analyzing the performance of the API.
